understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation match each goal, then step onto every goal cell to complete all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions and walls can block movement while still consuming stamina. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles change the corresponding piece attributes; rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise. A goal is activated only when all three attributes match. Stamina decreases with movement attempts or movement, and reaching zero costs a life; losing all lives ends the game.
